methodology: One representative primary or issuer-home listing per legal issuer. For dual-primary or multi-market issuers, selected venue is an editorial representative and not claimed to be exclusive. ADRs are excluded when a domestic/issuer-home line is represented. Tickers and venues marked inferred must be confirmed against the issuer or venue record before transaction use. Unknown means no defensible primary line was established.
